units.source_text: “独步说为恋爱而恋爱，我说为憎恨而憎恨。

en.t: Doppo says one loves for the sake of love; I say one hates for the sake of hatred.

units.source_text: 憎恨对贫穷的憎恨，憎恨对虚伪的憎恨，憎恨对一切的憎恨……”

en.t: Hatred that hates hatred of poverty, hatred that hates hatred of hypocrisy, hatred that hates hatred of everything...
